description:
Fetch a link and return a download URL, in one call. A Quark or PikPak share with folders or several
        files answers status "pick_required" with a `share_id` and its files: call again with `share_id` and the
        `file_id` of one file (open folders with `list_files`).

        Waits up to `wait_seconds` for the file to be ready. If it is not ready yet, the result has
        status "running" and a `job_id`: call `get_job`, then `get_download_link`.

        Social media posts (X, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Instagram): use `download_social` (a link given here is answered
        as it would answer).

file_id.description: The id of the one file to download, from the share's list
file_id.title: File Id

share_id.description: From a pick_required answer: the share the file is in
share_id.title: Share Id

url.description: Share or file link from a supported site
url.title: Url

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the file to be ready
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

name: download
title: Download a link
